### `lib/src/render_queue.dart`

- **variable** `final renderQueueProvider` — The app's one [RenderQueue], whose lock is this app's.
- **class `RenderQueue`** — Submits the viewer's queue records through `InsertionService.current`, writing each step into the record (§12.7).
  - `Stream<QueueChainFailure> get chainFailures` — Failed outcome writes, for the open page to say without owning the write.
  - `void listenToJobs()` — Hears terminal snapshots before insertion restores, keeping their own values through dismissal (§6.15).
  - `QueueJob? heardJob(String id)` — The terminal view heard this session, without actions after the service dismisses the job.
  - `Future<void> settle(String moment)` — Records heard outcomes only into the open film's viewer-owned queue items (§6.15).
  - `bool isRunning(BatchStem stem)` — Whether a pass of [stem] is under way in this app.
  - `static String? skippedAs(Map<String, dynamic> item)` — Why a pass leaves [item]: `submitted` (it has a job), `unresolved` (`submitting` without a job: its outcome was not recorded) or `refused` (an error); null for an item a pass takes.
  - `static bool eligible(Map<String, dynamic> item)` — Whether [item] may be taken by a pass: none of `job`, `submitting` and `error` (§6.15).
  - `static String endStatusOf(SetRecord record)` — The status a pass ends a record in: `submitted` where every item has a job or an error, else `pending`.
  - `Future<String?> submit(BatchStem stem, {Set<int>? only})` — Runs one pass over the queue [stem]: the record `submitting`, each eligible item in order, then `submitted` where every item has a job or an error, else `pending`.
  - `Future<bool> finishInterrupted(BatchStem stem)` — Finishes a pass that ended without its end — the app exited mid-pass, or its film was left — : the record, `submitting` with no pass of this app's, is written as a pass ends it, its unresolved items kept so (§6.15).
  - `Future<bool> markNotSubmitted(BatchStem stem, int n)` — *Mark as not submitted*: clears the `submitting` of item [n], unresolved, once the person has looked, so that the next pass takes it (§6.15).
